_comment: Script command types (wScriptCommandType) with names: the constant script lines use, the name of the implementation routine (the ScriptCommandXX_Run it replaces), and the evidence. Meanings are C1 readings of the messages the scripts show around the command and of the code (see the evidence entry).

E0.note: the inn: 'It's 0G a night. Will you...', 'Good morning and farewell!' (mode 1, bank $F0 strings)

E1.note: ends the inn session and clears wMessageMode

E2.note: the shop: 'What would you like to buy?', 'That comes to 0G. OK?'; reads ShopItemListTable and ItemValueTable (mode 2)

E3.note: ends the shop session ('Thank you! Please come again.' between its two calls) and clears wMessageMode

E5.note: the item Vault: 'What item should I store for...', 'What will you be taking out?' (mode 2)

E6.note: ends the Vault session (runs CloseShopMenu's code)

E8.note: Cobi's swap of party and farm monsters: 'What'll you switch it with?', 'I switched 0.' (mode 3, bank $1F strings)

E9.note: ends a menu session (runs CloseBreedMenu's code); follows the swap and NPC breeding menus

EB.note: monster hibernation: 'Which monster will hibernate?', 'Who should I wake up?' (mode 4, bank $1D strings)

EC.note: ends the hibernation session and clears wMessageMode

ED.note: breeding: 'Which will be the base monster?', 'And what will its mate be?' (mode 5, bank $1B strings)

EE.note: ends the breeding (and medal prize) session and clears wMessageMode

EF.note: egg appraisal and blessing: 'Which egg should I appraise?', 'Which egg should I bless?' (mode 6, bank $F2 strings)

F0.note: the Christener's renaming: 'Pick the monster to rename.' (runs EggServiceMenu's first state, so mode 6)

F1.note: ends the renaming session (runs CloseBreedMenu's code)

F2.note: Magic Key appraisal: 'Which Magic Key should I appraise?', 'Appraisal will cost 0G. OK?' (mode 7, bank $0D strings)

F3.note: the TinyMedal prize exchange: 'Which prize do you want?', 'I'll trade for 0 TinyMedals. OK?' (mode 7)

F4.note: breeding with a townsperson's monster picked by wScreenTableIndex: 'Who will breed with my SpikyBoy?' (mode 8, message bank $0E, + 16 * wScreenTableIndex)

F6.note: the monster library: 'Welcome to the library. Which family will you check?' (mode 9, bank $0B strings)

F7.note: the arena: 'The E Class should do. Which...', 'Congratulations! You did it!' (mode 10, bank $33 strings)

F8.note: the priest: 'Which monster should be revived?', curse removal (mode 11, bank $24 strings)
